description: The same hero tree, fully adult. A broad, heavy, softly lobed canopy of olive and moss green sitting directly on top of a stout fluted trunk that splits into three heavy limbs; the limbs are drawn clearly entering the underside of the canopy, and a small sky window beside the trunk shows the branch structure inside. Four buttress roots grip the ground and the bark carries vertical grain. This is ONE continuous woody organism: every leaf clump is carried on a branch that is drawn entering it from below, the bark of the trunk runs unbroken from the roots up into the branches, and there is no gap, seam or empty band anywhere between the trunk and the leaves. The foliage is never a separate ball floating above the tree. Pixel art on a fully transparent background. Low top-down two-and-a-half-D isometric camera, exactly the camera of the reference island plate: seen slightly from above and to the side. Warm brown bark with a cream-lit top edge and a dark umber shadow side; foliage in olive, moss and sap green with a warm sand-lit rim. A crisp dark outline around the whole silhouette. The tree stands alone, centred, with its root flare meeting the bottom-centre of the frame. NO ground, NO soil, NO grass tile, NO island, NO rock, NO shadow platform, NO border, NO frame, NO second tree, NO text. One single tree only.
